exact_statement: For every Boolean sign f on {0,1}^3, every product-bias vector p in {1/8,1/4,1/2,3/4,7/8}^3, and every nonempty proper physical block A, J_A <= M_A + Delta_A(p), with M_A=H(S_A|S_B), J_A=H(S_B)-E_Z H(mu_Z), Delta_A=sum_i_in_A[h2(p_i)+log2(max(p_i,1-p_i))], and mu_Z the inherited biased squared Fourier law of the actual restriction. Entropy is in bits.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean truth table, not arbitrary real amplitudes
Independent physical coordinates at the specified finite bias grid
Zero spectral masses contribute zero entropy
